name: push-up-close-hand-triceps
title: Push-Up (Close Hand, Triceps)
primer: This version of the Pushup isolates the triceps muscles.
steps: Kneel down on the floor or a mat, placing your hands with thumbs together, and raise yourself up on your toes.
Draw your abs in and keep your back and neck in a straight line.
Slowly lower your body towards the floor, by bending your arms, until you are nearly touching the floor.
In a controlled manner raise your body back up to the starting position.
